headline: Cómo conseguir unas ondas naturales
content: Para lograr este look, haz un moño alto antes de dormir. Cuando despierres, diluye las ondas suavemente con tus dedos. Otro método efectivo, en especial para el cabello escaso, es dividir tu melena en dos partes iguales y hacer dos trenzas. Al amanecer tendrás unas ondas muy naturales. También puedes recurrir a las pinzas o plancha.

headline: Esta zona del cuerpo delata el envejecimiento

headline: Consejo cómo crecer las pestañas deformación natural
content: Para alcanzar la longitud y el grosor deseado en las pestañas, tenga una dieta balanceada. La vitamina B ayuda a fortalecer las pestañas y se encuentra en alimentos como nueces, almendras, granos enteros y plátanos. Otros aliados son los ácidos grasos omega–3, así como los antioxidantes. Además, hidrate las pestañas a diario con algún aceite, ya sea de almendra o jojoba.

headline: Medics remove over a kilogram of jewelry from womans stomach
content: (India.) An emergency medical team extracted approximately a kilo and half worth of jewels and coins from a patient named Runi Bhattacharya’s stomach. Inside were found numerous chains, earrings, coins, medals, nose rings, and even house keys.

headline: Surprise visitor during pool game turns out to be snake hiding under table
content: (Australia.) Three friends playing snooker had their match interrupted when a snake emerged through one of the pockets of the table where it was nesting. Witnesses advised checking holes before reaching down next time.

headline: Between 19 dead identified after road crash near Canta, couple among victims planning wedding
content: (... ) Nineteen people died in a vehicle accident along the highway between Lima-Canta while traveling back home post-holiday celebrations. Among those killed was a young couple who planned to marry soon. Their group included three close companions heading towards Canta using a tour service company van which veered off course and collided against a hillside embankment.

headline: Woman throws dog from fifth floor balcony resulting in its death
content: (San Martin de Porres.) Residents witnessed a horrific event involving a mother throwing her pet dog from the fifth-floor balcony leading to its tragic demise. This cruel action sparked outrage within the community but resulted in minimal legal consequences despite public outcry.

headline: Police capture armed robber carrying modified pistol resembling professional weapon
content: (Ventanilla.) Affner Randy Miguel Narvaez Caro, aged 24, was apprehended possessing a firearm equipped with what appeared to be a suppressor akin to ones used by hitmen. His arrest highlights ongoing concerns about gun violence and criminal activities in urban areas.

headline: Family members assault police officers following drunk driving intervention
content: (San Juan de Miraflores.) Relatives attacked several policemen involved in arresting intoxicated technician Jesús Espinoza Alejos, age 40, causing injuries requiring further investigation. Such incidents underscore tensions surrounding law enforcement interventions especially concerning alcohol-related offenses.

headline: Victims family reveals victimization history prior to murder
content: (Callao.) Family disclosed previous harassment faced by Cecilia Pamela Costa Paredes, murdered by former partner military officer Adolfo Canales Lapozo. Her relatives expressed concern regarding his persistent attempts to reconcile amidst threats posed not just toward her but also other partners he previously engaged with.

headline: Community captures thieves until authorities release suspects citing lack of formal complaint
content: (Ate.) Local residents detained suspected pick-pockets caught stealing valuables from elderly individuals yet saw charges dropped once handed over to officials because there wasnt any official report filed initially—a situation highlighting gaps in procedural justice systems.

headline: Missing fugitive sought for assaulting lawyer sentenced to prison term
content: (Lima.) Adriano Pozo Arias remains elusive since being convicted last July for attacking attorney Arlette Contreras—an activist known widely across Peru—and now faces increased efforts including monetary rewards offered by government bodies aiming to locate him swiftly.

headline: Emergency landing leaves four injured amid technical issues mid-flight
content: (Loreto.) Four passengers sustained minor injuries upon forced descent conducted safely by pilot José Lim in response to mechanical failures detected shortly after departure bound for Pucallpa. Immediate evacuation procedures ensured passenger safety albeit raising questions around aircraft maintenance protocols.

headline: Plantón demands justice for slain model
content: (Trujillo.) Friends and kin gathered publicly demanding swift judicial actions against perpetrator responsible for killing fashion student Karina Marcella Copiapé Pérez, allegedly executed by security guard she confronted attempting theft.

headline: Volcano threat escalates as blockage causes pressure build-up potentially triggering larger eruptions
content: (Moquegua.) Volcanologist warns increasing risks associated with blocked volcanic vents beneath Mount Ubinas could lead to significant explosive events surpassing recent activity levels observed earlier this month.

headline: Balancing acts continue as city resumes traffic restrictions aimed at reducing congestion
content: (Lima.) content: El alcalde de La Molina y presidente de la Asociación Municipalidades del Perú (Ampe), Iván Paz de la Barra, señaló que muchos líderes políticos temen perder influencias actuales y critican duramente la idea de adelantar las elecciones generales sugerida por el presidente Martín Vizcarra.

headline: Malnutrición causa pérdida masiva de renos
content: Decenas de renos han muerto de hambre en Noruega debido al cambio climático, según grupos ambientalistas. Esta situación destaca problemas mayores asociados al impacto global del cambio climático.

headline: Alerta sanitaria por falta de regulación
content: Expertos advierten que el acceso universal al seguro integral de salud (SIS) necesita financiamiento suficiente para mejorar realmente la atención sanitaria. Actualmente, la carencia de fondos amenaza con deteriorar aún más la prestación de servicios básicos.

headline: Padres negligentes enfrentan consecuencias legales
content: Dos padres fueron arrestados después de dejar a su niño de dos meses en custodia temporal mientras ellos consumían alcohol. Personal de emergencia proporcionó ayuda inicial al bebé, destacándose nuevamente preocupaciones sobre responsabilidad parental.

headline: Operativos intensifican control de drogas ilícitas
